content.short: TradingView provides charts and data for technical analysis to traders and investors.
content.description: Since its founding in 2011, TradingView has become a leading charting and social platform for traders and investors. It covers major financial markets and supports cryptocurrencies across multiple blockchains. Users can explore various chart types, build and apply their own indicators, access rich data for analysis, and backtest trading strategies. Through advanced analytics, TradingView aims to help users make smarter investment decisions.
content.meta: TradingView is a charting and analytics platform for traders and investors. Discover TradingView and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
